title: Negative control: no leakage is claimed when outputs carry no attribute information

invariants.description: With a service whose model ignores the attribute, inversion must equal the auxiliary-only attacker exactly (observed +0/200 on 20/20 seeds).
The leakage test must not be significant (observed p = 1.0: no discordant pairs).
Every target must be reported ambiguous, i.e. the attack does not invent distinctions (observed 200/200).
Raw accuracy stays at the baseline's level (observed 138/200 = 69.0%), which is exactly why raw accuracy is never reported as leakage.

rationale: Guards against spurious leakage claims: high accuracy that comes entirely from auxiliary knowledge must produce zero advantage and no claim.
